This notebook holds the checks that sit between cleaning and the map: join
diagnostics, the exclusions log, the colour-band cut-offs, a hand check of three
practices against the raw files, and the callout facts tables that every number
on the panel comes from. It reads the outputs of `R/02_clean.R`; run that first.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load shared settings so thresholds, groups and colours match the scripts.
source(here::here("R", "00_settings.R"))
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)

practices <- read_csv(file.path(paths$processed, "practices.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
exclusions_log <- read_csv(file.path(paths$processed, "exclusions_log.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# Kept practices with the groups the callout tables use. Deprivation groups 4
# and 5 are merged: together they hold only 51 practices.
kept <- practices |>
  filter(kept) |>
  mutate(
    band = factor(band, c("least_busy", "typical", "busiest"),
                  c("Least busy", "Typical", "Busiest")),
    dep_group = factor(if_else(patient_quintile >= 4, "4-5", as.character(patient_quintile)),
                       c("1", "2", "3", "4-5")),
    size = cut(patients, size_breaks, size_labels, right = FALSE)
  )

pct <- \(x) round(100 * mean(x))
fmt <- \(x) format(round(x), big.mark = ",")
```

## Join checks

`R/02_clean.R` prints rows in, rows out and unmatched codes for every join. This
section confirms that the saved file is complete and stops the render if not.

```{r}
#| label: join-checks
checks <- tibble(
  check = c(
    "GM practices (ICB QOP)",
    "Practices with coordinates",
    "Practices inside the ten boroughs",
    "Practices with patient-weighted deprivation",
    "Kept practices",
    "Excluded practices (in the log)"
  ),
  value = c(
    nrow(practices),
    sum(!is.na(practices$east)),
    sum(!is.na(practices$borough)),
    sum(!is.na(practices$mean_patient_rank)),
    sum(practices$kept),
    nrow(exclusions_log)
  )
)
kable(checks)

stopifnot(
  all(!is.na(practices$east)),
  all(!is.na(practices$borough)),
  all(!is.na(practices$mean_patient_rank)),
  sum(practices$kept) + nrow(exclusions_log) == nrow(practices)
)
```

## Exclusions

Capacity exclusions are practices above `r fmt(max_patients_gp)` patients per
qualified GP, or with no qualified GP FTE. Data exclusions are missing or NA
workforce returns, or lists under `r fmt(min_list_size)` patients.

```{r}
#| label: exclusions
exclusions_log |>
  mutate(across(starts_with("fte_"), \(x) round(x, 2)),
         patients_per_gp = fmt(patients_per_gp)) |>
  kable()

n_capacity <- sum(exclusions_log$exclusion_type == "capacity")
n_data <- sum(exclusions_log$exclusion_type == "data")
footer_line <- footer_exclusions(nrow(practices), n_capacity, n_data)
```

Footer line, generated from this log:

> `r footer_line`

```{r}
#| label: capped-vs-kept
# Capped practices against kept ones, for the exclusions review.
practices |>
  filter(kept | exclusion_type == "capacity") |>
  mutate(group = if_else(kept, "Kept", "Capacity exclusion")) |>
  group_by(group) |>
  summarise(practices = n(),
            mean_qualified_fte = round(mean(fte_qualified), 2),
            mean_locum_trainee_fte = round(mean(fte_locum + fte_trainee), 2),
            median_list = fmt(median(patients))) |>
  kable()
```

## Colour bands

Quartiles of patients per GP across kept practices.

```{r}
#| label: bands
cuts <- quantile(kept$patients_per_gp, c(0.25, 0.75), names = FALSE)
kept |>
  group_by(band) |>
  summarise(practices = n(),
            from = fmt(min(patients_per_gp)), to = fmt(max(patients_per_gp))) |>
  kable()
```

```{r}
#| label: bands-plot
#| fig-height: 3
ggplot(kept, aes(patients_per_gp, fill = band)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 200, boundary = 0, colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = cuts, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = unname(band_colours[c("least_busy", "typical", "busiest")])) +
  labs(x = "Patients per qualified GP (FTE)", y = "Practices", fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Hand check against the raw files

One practice from each band, recomputed straight from the raw CSVs without the
cleaning code, then compared with `practices.csv`.

```{r}
#| label: hand-check
pick <- kept |>
  group_by(band) |>
  slice_min(abs(patients_per_gp - median(patients_per_gp)), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  pull(prac_code)

raw_wf <- read_csv(file.path(paths$raw, raw_files$workforce), na = character(),
                   col_types = cols(.default = col_character())) |>
  filter(PRAC_CODE %in% pick, STAFF_GROUP == "GP", MEASURE == "FTE",
         DETAILED_STAFF_ROLE %in% qualified_gp_roles) |>
  group_by(prac_code = PRAC_CODE) |>
  summarise(raw_fte = sum(as.numeric(VALUE)))
raw_pat <- read_csv(file.path(paths$raw, raw_files$patients), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(CODE %in% pick) |>
  select(prac_code = CODE, raw_patients = NUMBER_OF_PATIENTS)

hand <- kept |>
  filter(prac_code %in% pick) |>
  select(prac_code, prac_name, band, patients, fte_qualified, patients_per_gp) |>
  left_join(raw_pat, by = "prac_code") |>
  left_join(raw_wf, by = "prac_code") |>
  mutate(raw_ratio = raw_patients / raw_fte,
         match = patients == raw_patients & abs(fte_qualified - raw_fte) < 1e-9)
kable(mutate(hand, across(c(fte_qualified, raw_fte), \(x) round(x, 3)),
             across(c(patients_per_gp, raw_ratio), fmt)))
stopifnot(all(hand$match))
```

## Deprivation measures compared

Patient-weighted quintile (used for the callout facts) against the quintile of
the LSOA each surgery sits in.

```{r}
#| label: deprivation-compare
cat("Same quintile:", sum(kept$patient_quintile == kept$surgery_quintile), "of", nrow(kept), "\n")
table(patient_weighted = kept$patient_quintile, surgery = kept$surgery_quintile)
```

## Callout facts

Every number on the panel must come from one of these tables. Group 1 is the
most deprived national fifth, by the mean IMD rank of each practice's patients.

### A. Deprivation group and band

```{r}
#| label: facts-deprivation
facts_dep <- kept |>
  group_by(dep_group) |>
  summarise(practices = n(),
            pct_busiest = pct(band == "Busiest"),
            pct_least_busy = pct(band == "Least busy"),
            median_patients_per_gp = fmt(median(patients_per_gp)),
            pooled_patients_per_gp = fmt(sum(patients) / sum(fte_qualified)),
            median_list = fmt(median(patients)))
kable(facts_dep)
cat(sprintf("Rank correlation, patient deprivation rank vs patients per GP: %+.2f\n",
            cor(kept$mean_patient_rank, kept$patients_per_gp, method = "spearman")))
```

### B. Practice size and band

```{r}
#| label: facts-size
facts_size <- kept |>
  group_by(size) |>
  summarise(practices = n(),
            pct_busiest = pct(band == "Busiest"),
            pct_least_busy = pct(band == "Least busy"),
            median_patients_per_gp = fmt(median(patients_per_gp)),
            pooled_patients_per_gp = fmt(sum(patients) / sum(fte_qualified)),
            median_qualified_fte = round(median(fte_qualified), 1),
            pct_in_group_1 = pct(dep_group == "1"))
kable(facts_size)
```

### C. Size within each deprivation group

Separates the two: does size still matter once deprivation is held fixed? Medium
and large are merged so each cell keeps enough practices.

```{r}
#| label: facts-size-within-dep
facts_cross <- kept |>
  mutate(size2 = if_else(patients < size_breaks[2], "Small", "Medium or large")) |>
  group_by(dep_group, size2) |>
  summarise(practices = n(),
            pct_busiest = pct(band == "Busiest"),
            median_patients_per_gp = fmt(median(patients_per_gp)),
            .groups = "drop")
kable(facts_cross)
```

### E. Callout clusters

The three places the panel's numbered callouts point at, and the sentences
printed for them. Both come from `R/callout_facts.R`, which `R/03_map.R` also uses.

```{r}
#| label: facts-clusters
source(here::here("R", "callout_facts.R"))
facts <- callout_facts(practices |> filter(kept))
facts$clusters |>
  select(id, title, n, n_small, n_busy, n_group_1, median_list, body) |>
  mutate(median_list = fmt(median_list)) |>
  kable()
cat(sprintf("Subheadline: %d%% of small practices busiest, %d%% of large.\n",
            facts$headline$pct_small_busy, facts$headline$pct_large_busy))
```

### D. Headline figures

```{r}
#| label: facts-headline
tibble(
  figure = c("Practices on the map", "Registered patients at those practices",
             "Median patients per GP", "Busiest band starts at",
             "Least busy band ends at"),
  value = c(fmt(nrow(kept)), fmt(sum(kept$patients)),
            fmt(median(kept$patients_per_gp)), fmt(cuts[2]), fmt(cuts[1]))
) |> kable()
```
